name: ryu.isitagentready
description: Scan a public website with Is Your Site Agent-Ready? (https://isitagentready.com): a live check of robots.txt and AI bot rules, sitemaps, Link headers, Markdown negotiation, MCP and A2A cards, Agent Skills, WebMCP, OAuth discovery and agent commerce protocols, scored as a readiness level from 0 (Not Ready) to 5 (Agent-Native). Keyless.
